title: pleuroplitis langsdorffii var. centrasiatica
intro: Pleuroplitis langsdorffii var. centrasiatica, commonly known as  Asian valerian, is a type of flowering plant in the Valerianaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Pleuroplitis langsdorffii var. centrasiatica include its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of insomnia, restlessness, and nervousness. The bioactive constituents of this plant include valerenic acid, valeranone, and other sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
